summary: Intake readiness remains blocked for Registration. Evidence reviewed: `.ai_factory/delivery/intakes/13612888-96ef-4fa4-a304-4a400d9f2e24.md` requests Google/GitHub registration for module `feedback`; `.env.local` now contains `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID`, `GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET`, `GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN`, `GITHUB_ID`, and `GITHUB_SECRET`, but no PostgreSQL connection variable or auth/session secret was present by variable name. `package.json` has only Next/React dependencies and no auth or database integration library. Search across `.ai_factory`, `src`, `package.json`, `next.config.ts`, `playwright.config.ts`, and `tsconfig.json` found no existing registration/auth architecture, and `src/features/landing/content.ts` still describes authentication and persistence as future work. No iteration plan is present under `.ai_factory/delivery/planning/`. No tests were run for this readiness review.

defects.description: Human clarification says PostgreSQL variables were added, but environment variable-name inspection found only Google/GitHub OAuth-related keys and no `DATABASE_URL`, `POSTGRES_*`, or equivalent database connection setting. Successful customer record creation cannot be designed or validated without a concrete database connection contract.

The intake and project docs do not define the auth/session strategy, required callback URLs, redirect behavior, customer account model, or duplicate-account linking rules. The repository also has no selected auth dependency such as NextAuth/Auth.js.

No iteration plan was present under `.ai_factory/delivery/planning/`, and the only current `.ai_factory/docs` artifact is the project brief. Requirements/design/security/operations expectations for OAuth registration and persistence are not yet documented.
